name: io.github.mabhishe/eventpass
title: EventPass
description: Discover community events and buy tickets; organizers check sales and payments by chat.

tools.name: listEvents
tools.description: List upcoming published EventPass events with starting prices. Use this first to discover what's on.

tools.name: getEvent
tools.description: Get full details for one event: description, ticket types with prices, live availability, program, and food vendors. Use the slug from listEvents.

tools.name: createOrder
tools.description: Place a ticket order. The buyer pays the organizer DIRECTLY (Interac e-Transfer, Zelle, or cash) — EventPass never touches the money. Returns the order reference code and payment instructions to relay to the buyer. Free ($0) orders confirm immediately. Pass idempotency_key (a unique key per order, at least 16 characters — e.g. a UUID) to make retries safe: a retry with the same key and the same buyer, items, and contact returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate. Pass promoCode for a discount code from the event — it is validated server-side, and an invalid, expired, or used-up code rejects the order.

payMethod.description: How the buyer will pay the organizer directly

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key: a unique key per order, at least 16 characters (e.g. a UUID). A retry with the same key returns the original order — no duplicate is created. The key is bound to this buyer, these items, and this contact: reusing it for a different order is refused. Optional; without it each call creates a new order.

promoCode.description: Promo / discount code for this event (optional). Validated server-side; an invalid, expired, or used-up code rejects the order.

tools.name: findTickets
tools.description: Find a buyer's orders and have the ticket link emailed to the email on the order. This SENDS an email — it is not a read-only lookup — and the link goes out only when the buyer has at least one confirmed ticket; a pending (unpaid) order gets no email. Privacy-guarded: needs the exact full name and the exact email or phone used at checkout, like the website's lookup. The link is emailed, never returned here, so only the email owner can open the order page.

name.description: Full name on the order, exactly as entered at checkout

contact.description: The exact email or phone used at checkout

tools.name: list_my_organizations
tools.description: List the EventPass organizations you belong to, with your role in each and whether AI features (and AI writes) are enabled for it. Use this first when you belong to several organizations, to pick the organization_id for the other tools. This lists only your own memberships — it never shows other organizations.

tools.name: list_my_events
tools.description: List events in one of your organizations, newest first. Use this to find an event_id for the sales, attendee, pending-payment, and check-in tools. Filter by status when you only want drafts, published, closed, or archived events.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

status.description: Only events with this status. Omit for all statuses.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.description: Sales summary for one event: confirmed and pending orders, tickets sold, money collected, and money still outstanding, plus a breakdown by payment method. Collected means money the organizer has actually received (confirmed orders); outstanding is what pending orders still owe. Use this to answer 'how are sales going?' for an event.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

tools.name: get_attendee_list
tools.description: List the attendees (tickets) for one event: holder name, ticket type, and check-in status. Paginated — default 20, max 100 per call. Cancelled tickets are excluded unless include_cancelled is true. Email and phone are deliberately NOT returned here; use get_pending_payments when you need to contact someone about a payment. Owner/Admin/Staff only.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: get_pending_payments
tools.description: Orders for one event that are still waiting for payment: buyer name, contact (email/phone — included here because chasing a payment needs it), amount owed, payment method, and an opaque lookup token per order. Oldest first, so the longest-waiting payments come first. This is the list to work through when following up on unpaid orders. Use order_lookup to confirm a payment (confirm_pending_payment). The order ID itself is never shown here (round 3, N-2): it is the bearer key to the order page, so the lookup token stands in for it and cannot open the order page.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: get_checkin_stats
tools.description: Check-in stats for one event: how many tickets are issued, how many have checked in, how many have not, and how many were cancelled, with the same breakdown per ticket type. Use this on the day of the event to see who is still expected.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a new event as a DRAFT — it is never published by this tool. The draft is invisible to buyers until publish_event. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false), show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to create it. Add ticket types and publish from the dashboard, or with publish_event.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

date.description: Event date and time. An ISO string (2026-12-31T19:00:00Z) or a wall clock in the organization's timezone (2026-12-31T19:00).

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Toronto. Defaults to the organization's timezone.

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. CAD. Default CAD.

etransfer_email.description: Interac e-Transfer email buyers pay to (for paid events).

attendance_model.description: PAID (ticketed), FREE_REGISTRATION (free, with tickets), or FREE_COUNTS (free, headcount only).

food_model.description: ORGANIZER (organizer sells food), VENDORS (vendor stalls), or NONE.

require_entry_qr.description: Whether entry needs a QR code. Default true.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). REQUIRED. Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again. A retry with a different key (or none) may create a second event or send a second broadcast.

tools.name: publish_event
tools.description: Publish a DRAFT event so buyers can see it and buy tickets. Only drafts can be published — closed or archived events must be reopened from the dashboard. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false): the preview shows the date, ticket types with prices, and whether the plan allows another published event. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true to publish.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again.

tools.name: confirm_pending_payment
tools.description: Record that a manual payment was received for ONE pending order (e.g. an Interac e-Transfer that just arrived) and confirm the order, issuing its tickets and sending the buyer their tickets email. This records a payment — it does NOT move money and never touches Stripe; the money already went directly to the organizer. One order per call, no bulk confirm. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false): the preview shows the buyer, the amount owed, and whether this payment covers it. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true to record and confirm. Identify the order with order_lookup from get_pending_payments (preferred — the raw order ID is never shown to the AI, round 3 N-2), or order_id / order_ref when the user supplies one.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

order_lookup.description: Opaque lookup token from get_pending_payments — use this to confirm. Preferred: the raw order ID is never shown to the AI.

order_id.description: Order ID — only when the user supplies it directly (e.g. from the dashboard). Prefer order_lookup.

order_ref.description: Order reference code (the code the buyer puts in their e-Transfer message) — only when you do not have the order lookup or ID. get_pending_payments returns the order lookup, not the reference.

amount_cents.description: Amount received, in cents (2500 = $25.00). This is recorded as a manual payment on the order.

reference.description: e-Transfer reference, memo, or note — stored on the payment record.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again.

tools.name: send_broadcast
tools.description: Send one email to every buyer with a CONFIRMED order for an event — each personalized with their own name and ticket details. Email only (no WhatsApp for freeform broadcasts). At most 200 recipients per call; larger audiences must use the dashboard. Broadcasts are limited to 3 per hour per organization, shared with the dashboard. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false): the preview shows the exact subject, the message, and the recipient count. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to send.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

body.description: Email body (1–20,000 characters). Use {buyer_name}, {event_title}, {event_date}, {entry_code} for personalization.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). REQUIRED. Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again. A retry with a different key (or none) may create a second event or send a second broadcast.

tools.name: delete_draft_event
tools.description: Permanently delete a DRAFT event with zero orders — the cleanup for a test draft. Only drafts with no orders can be deleted (anything with an order is refused; archive it from the dashboard instead). 'Orders' means ticket orders and vendor food orders — both cascade-delete with the event, so both count. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false): the preview shows the event title, date, and that it has zero orders and will be permanently deleted. Show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to delete it. The idempotency key is bound to this event: reusing it for a different event_id is refused. A retry with the same key for the same event returns the already-deleted result instead of erroring.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). REQUIRED. Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again. A retry with a different key (or none) may create a second event or send a second broadcast.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List the team members of one organization: name, email, role, and whether each member is deactivated. Owner/Admin only. Use the member id from here for the other team tools.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: invite_team_member
tools.description: Add an existing EventPass user to the team of one organization. The email must already have an EventPass account — when it doesn't, confirming refuses without saying whether the account exists (create their login in the dashboard first, then invite them). Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false), show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to add them. Owner/Admin only; only an Owner can grant the Owner role.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

email.description: Their email address (must already have an EventPass account).

role.description: Team role: ORG_OWNER (full access, only an Owner can grant it), ORG_ADMIN (events, team, reports, sell, confirm, check-in), ORG_STAFF (sell + confirm), ORG_DOOR (door page + walk-ins).

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and getting their approval. Default false: returns a preview of exactly what would happen and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this write (e.g. a UUID). REQUIRED. Reuse the exact same key if you retry this call — a replay returns the original result instead of executing again. A retry with a different key (or none) may create a second event or send a second broadcast.

tools.name: set_team_member_role
tools.description: Change a team member's role. Only an Owner can grant the Owner role. The org Owner's role can never be changed, and you cannot change your own role. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false), show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to change it. Owner/Admin only.

member_id.description: Team member ID (the membership id) from list_team_members.

tools.name: deactivate_team_member
tools.description: Deactivate a team member: they lose access to this organization, but the record — and every order they sold — is kept. The org Owner can never be deactivated, and you cannot deactivate yourself. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false), show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to deactivate them. Owner/Admin only.

organization_id.description: Organization ID. Required when you belong to several organizations — use list_my_organizations to see them. Omit it when you belong to exactly one.

member_id.description: Team member ID (the membership id) from list_team_members.

tools.name: reactivate_team_member
tools.description: Reactivate a deactivated team member: they get access to this organization back. Call once to preview (confirm defaults to false), show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the same idempotency_key to reactivate them. Owner/Admin only.
